description: Mediation Boards Commission - Calling for the Nominations for the appointment of Mediators
categorisation: This gazette notification concerns the appointment of mediators for Mediation Boards, which falls under judicial/law enforcement matters. It involves calling for nominations for judicial dispute resolution positions (Chairman and Mediators) under the Mediation Boards Act, establishing eligibility criteria, and outlining the appointment process through the Mediation Boards Commission - all of which align with Type 9 (Judicial/Law Enforcement Gazettes) for court-related appointments and judicial matters.
